# AGC at max gain - magnet too far, move it CLOSER
# upright reference 3536 counts (saved); startup retains it
# Cart defaults: leff=0.124 m, vmax=1.500 m/s, amax_s=25.0, amax_b=25.0 m/s^2, jmax=150.0 m/s^3
# Startup position is x=0: place cart at physical center before reset; no homing motion.
# Travel 300 mm; normal range +/-135 mm. Predictive braking -> return inside range; fault +/-140 mm.
# Pendulum |theta_dot| >150.00 rad/s: brake, center, then resume below 10.00 rad/s; no full-turn check or dwell.
# bal: explicit upright-only start within 10deg; >50deg fall brakes, centers and disables; no restart.
# Drivers DISABLED. Motion commands enable; stop disables all drivers.
# pins cart STEP=2 DIR=3; Z1 STEP=4 DIR=5; Z2 STEP=6 DIR=7
# vmax is the hard ceiling; vmax_s/vmax_b select swing/balance limits. Capture speed is catch_v.
